scope: ONE coherent F3 captured-tape identity seam: the pipeline ReplayRun class-declared identity (class + role + owned kind + two-input NodeSpec contract) and the tape-pair grammar keyed on that class-declared identity. The class EXISTS and is registered owned this slice, so the owned-kind name is a registry key, not a bare string.
non_goals: verified PUBLISHED/CAPTURED identity resolution and the composed tape capability (follow-on)
a second planner, ledger, or tape engine
imposing the tape pair on every P4 replay admission

identity.class: dskit.pipeline ReplayRun (Node subclass), role = "replay", registered register_node_kind(REPLAY_RUN_KIND, ReplayRun, owned=True).
identity.role: new ROLES member "replay" (document.py). The document NodeSpec.role key remains cross-checked redundancy.
identity.node_spec_contract: ReplayRun declares exactly two required inputs tape_manifest and tape_data, each a complete legal P5 $captured_artifact descriptor.
identity.run: ReplayRun.run consumes the two captured inputs through CapturedBindings and returns an opaque ReplayTapeBinding (the F3 composed-tape->runtime-ReplayTape seam is follow-on). This is the identity seam's minimal honest behavior, not fabricated verification.

enforcement.parse: document.py, keyed on NodeSpec.uses == REPLAY_RUN_KIND (the owned registry key — class-declared because the class is registered owned this slice): the node must be in an execution_backtest document AND declare inputs exactly {tape_manifest, tape_data}, each a complete P5 descriptor. A non-execution document referencing REPLAY_RUN_KIND refuses.
enforcement.class_ref_spelling: the owned-role doctrine (planner stat_test pattern) refuses a class ref whose cls.role == "replay" as non-owned for any document that reaches plan; execution documents do not reach plan, and their class-ref spelling is the broker route's follow-on concern. This slice's pair rule keys on the owned-kind spelling.
enforcement.resolves: convergence F1 (parse is the single reachable enforcement point; no plan-time claim) and F2 (the class is registered owned, so the owned name is the class, not a squatted string).

positive_grammar.pair: inputs == {tape_manifest: {$captured_artifact: D1}, tape_data: {$captured_artifact: D2}}; D1, D2 each an exact P5 six-field descriptor.

cases: a third input key beside the pair
a renamed port carrying a descriptor
a descriptor as a list/map input value
a non-ReplayRun node declaring the two tape ports not swept
a class ref with cls.role == 'replay' refused as non-owned (stat_test pattern)

compatibility.p4_replay: pair rule fires only on the ReplayRun owned kind; accepted P4 final-replay fixtures remain green.
compatibility.p5_p6: descriptor shape and generic equality unchanged.
compatibility.purity: pipeline never imports production; ReplayRun is pipeline-owned.

forbidden_effects: planning/stage compilation completes before grammar refusal
uses-string resemblance or document role key as identity authority

tests.new: tests/pipeline/test_replay_tape_descriptors.py: positive pair; missing/extra/aliased/nested/wrong_name/identity; non-execution replay-kind refusal; class-ref-with-replay-role owned refusal (synthetic test class); P4 compatibility.
